title: Skill Fields

fields.label: Icon
fields.name: skill_icon
fields.instructions: Select an icon from the library (displayed on archive cards)

fields.label: Description
fields.name: skill_description
fields.instructions: Main description text for the skill (used in hero and archive cards)

fields.label: Video Thumbnail
fields.name: video_thumbnail
fields.instructions: Thumbnail image displayed in content. Clicking opens the gated video modal.

fields.label: Video URL
fields.name: video_url
fields.instructions: Full embed URL for the video (Vimeo or YouTube). Example: https://player.vimeo.com/video/123456789

fields.label: HubSpot Form ID
fields.name: hubspot_form_id
fields.instructions: HubSpot form ID to gate the video. Leave empty for ungated video. Example: 097ee201-0440-4b59-a68e-d682966a8e08

fields.label: Content Sections
fields.name: content_sections
fields.instructions: Define the main content sections for this skill. These will appear in both the top tabs and sidebar navigation. Requires ACF Pro.

sub_fields.label: Navigation Label
sub_fields.name: label
sub_fields.instructions: Label for tabs and sidebar navigation

sub_fields.label: Anchor ID
sub_fields.name: anchor
sub_fields.instructions: Unique anchor ID (e.g., 'overview', 'use-cases'). Will be auto-generated from label if left empty.

fields.label: Read how It Works URL
fields.name: read_how_it_works_url
fields.instructions: Optional: URL for 'Read how It Works' button. Leave empty to hide the button.

fields.label: Explore more URL
fields.name: explore_more_url
fields.instructions: Optional: URL for 'Explore more' button. Leave empty to hide the button.

description: Custom fields for Skills. Note: Repeater fields require ACF Pro.
